jobs.title: Software Engineer, Payments Infrastructure
Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Risk
jobs.content: <div><p>The Risk org keeps fraud losses low without slowing legitimate businesses down.</p><p><strong>Requirements</strong></p><ul><li>7+ years applying machine learning to production problems.</li><li>Fluency in Python and SQL; comfort with Spark or an equivalent.</li><li>Experience owning model quality end to end, including monitoring.</li></ul></div>

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Compliance
jobs.content: <p>Coordinate the compliance programmes that keep Stripe licensed in the markets it operates in.</p><ul><li>6+ years in programme management inside a regulated business.</li><li>Comfort writing for auditors and for engineers in the same week.</li></ul>
